title: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?
englishTitle: Which dish is safest for this allergy?
pronunciation: Mon an nao an toan nhat cho nguoi bi di ung nay
summary: For asking staff to steer you toward the safest dish for a specific allergy or restriction.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this before ordering when the menu has several risky-looking choices and you need staff to narrow it down.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the allergy note first, then ask for the safest dish. Wait for one clear recommendation.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Start with Món ăn nào + an toàn nhất; the full audio shows how the words connect in one breath.

breakdown.vietnamese: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at a restaurant counter or table before the kitchen starts cooking.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể làm món này không có nguyên liệu này được không?
phrases.english: Can you make it without this ingredient?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the lam mon nay khong co nguyen lieu nay duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
phrases.english: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
phrases.pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A safe dish needs a clear answer, not just a friendly nod. Ask again if the reply feels vague.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep fish-sauce, shellfish, and cannot-eat-this cards nearby if the answer turns uncertain.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi món này mà không có thịt được không?
phrases.english: Can I order this without meat?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the goi mon nay ma khong co thit duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng
phrases.pronunciation: toy bee zee oong dow fohng

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Use no-meat or without-this-ingredient cards when you already know which dish you want.
